(()=>{window.VW=(key,frac,h,ah,lat)=>{const idx=D.findIndex(d=>d._key===key);if(window._vt!==idx){PT8.launch({mode:'mp',rally:true,track:idx,laps:1,humans:[{id:'ford',alt:0}],ai:[]});RACE.state='race';window._vt=idx}const T=RACE.T,N=T.N,k=Math.floor((T.finI||N)*frac),c=Math.cos(T.psi[k]),s=Math.sin(T.psi[k]),l=lat||0;const cam=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(62,16/9,.1,3000);const x=T.x[k]+c*l,z=T.z[k]-s*l;cam.position.set(x,Math.max(T.y[k],T.surf(x,z,T.y[k]+50).h)+h,z);const k2=(k+(ah||12))%N;cam.lookAt(T.x[k2],T.y[k2]+(h>20?0:1.2),T.z[k2]);window.drawRace=()=>{R.render(RACE.scene,cam)};return T.d.name+' N='+N+' fin='+T.finI+' L='+Math.round(T.L)+' segs='+(T._bx&&T._bx.segs.length)};return D.map((d,i)=>i+':'+d.name+(d.stage?'*':'')).join(', ')})()
